name: NEAR SHOEMAKER
missionStatus: Mission complete (2001). Resting on asteroid 433 Eros.

model.note: Simplified visual reconstruction built in-app. Not an official NASA model.

briefNotes.text: NEAR Shoemaker was the first spacecraft to orbit an asteroid. Its landing on Eros was not part of the original mission design; it survived and kept transmitting.
briefNotes.origin: Team research brief (NASA-based); final check against NASA sources recommended
